newsitem.title: USA: LDC debt prices boosted by rising U.S. Treasuries.
newsitem.headline: LDC debt prices boosted by rising U.S. Treasuries.

text.p: Emerging market debt prices were quoted about 3/4 of a point higher on Tuesday, boosted by rising U.S. Treasuries, traders said.
"The market was boosted by Treasuries... People are viewing this market as still yield attractive," said one trader.
Traders said volume was heavy with players keying in on the upcoming supply of new debt, traders said.
Argentine bonds were boosted by Tuesday's successful launch of the country's 10-year global bond via joint lead managers Goldman Sachs and Salomon Brothers.
"The Argentina deal was a blowout in London...it met with overwhelming demand," said one corporate high-grade syndicate source in New York.
After meeting with overwhelming investor demand, Argentina increased the size of its global bond issue to $1.0 billion from an initial $750 million, the Argentine Economic Ministry said on Tuesday.

"Even though the initial amount was for $750 million, the excellent response that this issue had in the international financial community brought us to increase the issue to $1.0 billion," the ministry said in a statement.
